name: xdoc
description:
Convert PPTX decks into PDF, PNG, JSON, and Markdown outputs, and HTML into Markdown.

Accepts single files, multiple files, glob patterns (?/*/**), and
directories. With --recursive, subdirectories are walked.

Shorthand:
  xdoc <inputs...> [options]  ==  xdoc convert <inputs...> [options]

Structured extraction:
  xdoc extract <inputs...> --parts map,resources,notes,links,fonts

HTML to Markdown:
  xdoc html2md page.html --output page.md

Preflight diagnostics:
  xdoc check <inputs...> --checks fonts,links,compat

PPTX editing bridge:
  xdoc pptx new --output out.pptx
  xdoc pptx apply --patch patch.json --input in.pptx --output out.pptx

  xdoc pptx inspect deck.pptx --json

  xdoc pptx select deck.pptx --query query.json --json

  xdoc pptx preview deck.pptx --output-dir shots/ --contact-sheet out.png --json

  xdoc pptx chrome-detect deck.pptx --json

  xdoc pptx chrome-remove deck.pptx --roles header,footer,page-number,rule --output clean.pptx

  xdoc pptx chrome-apply deck.pptx --deckkit mckinsey-blue --output styled.pptx

  xdoc pptx refurbish-skin --source old.pptx --deckkit mckinsey-blue --output new.pptx

  xdoc pptx apply-brand deck.pptx --brand brand.json --output out.pptx

  xdoc pptx copy-from target.pptx --from source.pptx --slide 0 --output out.pptx

  xdoc pptx extract-style deck.pptx --output style.json --json

  xdoc pptx import-template reference.pptx --name imported-template --output skills/pptx-nova/assets --json

  xdoc pptx catalog shapes --json

  xdoc pptx list-themes --json

  xdoc pptx swap-theme deck.pptx --to corporate-blue --output out.pptx

  xdoc pptx swap-style deck.pptx --to consulting --output out.pptx

  xdoc pptx recipe --patch recipe.json --compile --json

  xdoc pptx replay --from-sidecar out.pptx.xdoc.json --output recovered.pptx

  xdoc pptx audit --from-sidecar out.pptx.xdoc.json --json

  xdoc pptx rollback --from-sidecar out.pptx.xdoc.json --output recovered.pptx

PDF diagnostics and text extraction:
  xdoc pdf inspect out.pdf --json
  xdoc pdf extract-text input.pdf --json --pretty
  xdoc pdf render input.pdf --pages 1,3-5 --output pages/

Machine-readable schema:
  xdoc schema

usageNotes: Accepts files, glob patterns (?/*/**), and directories.
Use --recursive to descend into subdirectories.
Use --out-dir to collect every source's outputs under a single root.
--output is only valid with a single input file; --out-dir is always available.
--fail-fast is batch-only; --report also works for single-file convert runs.
Use --report to write a stable batch/v1 JSON summary for scripts and agents.

usageNotes: Calls hustcer/pptx_gen bridge APIs directly; does not shell out to cmd/pptx-gen.
Use action new to create a minimal deck, apply to patch an existing or new deck, or inspect to summarize an existing deck.
For inspect, pass either `xdoc pptx inspect deck.pptx --json` or `xdoc pptx inspect --input deck.pptx --json`.

Use `xdoc pptx vision-check deck.pptx --json` to statically QA an existing deck without rendering: it flags geometry overlaps, off-slide and edge-hugging text, text-overflow estimates, unexpected wraps in single-line text roles, misaligned card rows, and sub-threshold fonts, and each issue may carry an auto-applicable fixPatch.
Use `xdoc pptx preview deck.pptx --output-dir shots/ --contact-sheet out.png --json` to render per-slide PNG previews plus an optional contact sheet and stdout manifest for multimodal review.

Use `xdoc pptx contact-diff --source old.pptx --candidate new.pptx --output contact-diff.png --json` to generate a source/candidate side-by-side contact sheet plus changed/unchanged/missing/added slide status; pass `--map reference-map.json` for split/merge/reordered refurbish mapping.

Use `xdoc pptx i18n-text-plan --source old.pptx --data translations.json --json` before applying translation patches: it emits run-level set-run patchOps and marks mixed-style paragraphs review-required when styled-token anchors are not reliable.

Use `xdoc pptx i18n-style-diff --source old.pptx --candidate translated.pptx --json` as the translation-mode gate: it ignores text node content, blocks non-size run/paragraph/textbox/table/chart style signature changes, and records font-size-only layout repairs.
Use `xdoc pptx refurbish-audit --source old.pptx --final new.pptx --json` after skin-first refurbish to verify source/final preservation gates.

Use `xdoc pptx refurbish-skin --source old.pptx --deckkit mckinsey-blue --output new.pptx --json` to copy-preserve an existing deck, replace chrome/background, remap retained objects, and run audit/vision gates; run contact-diff explicitly for manual review.
Use `xdoc pptx chrome-detect deck.pptx --json` to identify candidate headers, footers, page numbers, and rules before removing or replacing old deck chrome.
Use `xdoc pptx chrome-remove deck.pptx --roles header,footer,page-number,rule --output clean.pptx` to delete high-confidence old chrome using real remove-shape patch ops.
Use `xdoc pptx chrome-apply deck.pptx --deckkit mckinsey-blue --output styled.pptx` to add deterministic DeckKit-derived native page chrome.
Use `xdoc pptx remap-theme deck.pptx --to corporate-blue --scope text,shapes --output out.pptx` to batch remap retained native objects toward a target themePack.
Use `xdoc pptx from-data data.json --template template.pptx --bindings bindings.json --output out.pptx` to run a bind-data patch without writing the wrapper patch JSON yourself.
Use `xdoc pptx import-template reference.pptx --name stable-id --output skills/pptx-nova/assets --json` to extract a reusable template profile and register it in the pptx-nova asset catalogs.
Use `xdoc pptx recipe --patch recipe.json --compile --json` to compile high-level recipe ops into ordinary patch JSON before apply.
Use `--asset-root <dir>` with apply to resolve schema-v1 assetSource.path values; omitted asset roots default to the patch file directory.

Use `--daemon` on apply/inspect to reuse an existing daemon session when available; inspect reuses the parsed deck directly, while apply patches a serialized candidate snapshot before commit for atomic failure handling.
Use `--daemon-strict` when an Agent workflow requires daemon reuse and should fail instead of falling back.
--output is required for new/apply unless --dry-run is set. Inspect never writes output.

assetRoot.pathSecurity: assetSource.path must be relative and remain inside the resolved asset root

apply.usage: xdoc pptx apply --patch patch.json [--input in.pptx] --output out.pptx [--daemon]

daemon.sessionKey: canonical input path; after save, the session is also keyed by output path
daemon.fallback: --daemon falls back to one-shot apply when the daemon is unavailable; --daemon-strict does not
daemon.dryRun: Serializes a snapshot and leaves the in-memory session unchanged.

inspect.perSlideGeometry: each slide carries geometryOverlaps[] and textOverflowEstimates[] — the same overlap and text-overflow signals vision-check computes, so Edit-mode callers see geometry risk in one inspect pass (contrast and decoration-over-title still need a PNG pass)

daemon.fallback: --daemon falls back to one-shot inspect when the daemon is unavailable; --daemon-strict does not

scope.effect: summary/issues follow the selected slides; deckSummary/deckIssues retain full-deck evidence and deckResidualRisk discloses issues outside the scope

fix.shape: each issue may carry fix.fixPatch (set-shape-position / set-shape-size) plus fix.reason, fix.confidence, fix.autoRetry
fix.loop: merge autoRetry:true fixPatch entries into a patch, re-apply, then re-run vision-check; PNG review still covers contrast and decoration-over-title

diff.usage: xdoc pptx diff before.pptx after.pptx --json [--detail summary|full]

detailModes.summary: default compact rollup for agents and CI; omits per-shape evidence arrays and points to --detail full when evidence is needed
detailModes.full: complete per-slide/per-shape/per-field evidence with hashes and previews

diff.successCriteria: xdoc pptx diff emits deterministic conclusions only for stably identified slide/shape/text/media/table/chart summaries; unstable matches and unsupported structures are reported as uncertain/unsupported instead of presented as facts.

stdout.format: json when --json is set; human summary otherwise

matching.shapes: unique shape id + element kind, falling back to unique shape name + element kind
matching.uncertain: ambiguous or non-unique fallback keys are reported as uncertain instead of guessed

agentPolicy.ciPolicy: Use summary reliable counts/rollups as machine facts; request --detail full only when evidence is needed, and pair semantic diff with preview or visual diff.

i18n-style-diff.strategy: Compare textless OOXML style signatures after copying source deck and replacing visible text in place.

allowedChanges.fontSize: Only sz attribute changes are allowed, and they are reported under allowedChanges.fontSize for layout repair review.

stdout.format: json when --json is set; human summary otherwise

ioContract.exitStatus: 0 when style gate passes; non-zero when blockers are found or inputs are invalid

agentPolicy.failWhen: agentGate.passed is false or blockers[] is non-empty
agentPolicy.repairHint: Regenerate from a copied source deck and replace text at text-node/run level; never collapse mixed-style runs into one run.

i18n-text-plan.strategy: Inspect existing DrawingML text runs and decide whether each translation unit can be safely mapped without rebuilding paragraphs or run properties.

translationUnit.indexing: slide is 1-based; paragraph is 0-based; shapeId is the source PPTX cNvPr id.

strategies.uniform: Single source run receives the full target text.
strategies.preserve-run-boundaries: Multiple source runs share one style signature; the first run receives the full target and continuation runs are cleared while their style nodes remain.
strategies.preserve-styled-token-boundaries: Mixed-style runs keep styled token anchors in their original run boundaries and distribute surrounding target text to adjacent plain runs.
strategies.review-required: The planner could not prove a safe run-level mapping; do not auto-apply the unit.

stdout.format: json when --json is set; human summary otherwise

ioContract.exitStatus: 0 only when all in-scope units have deterministic patchOps; non-zero when review-required or invalid inputs are found

agentPolicy.applyOnlyWhen: agentGate.passed is true and reviewRequiredCount is 0
blockedWhen: mixed-style paragraph has no reliable target anchor for a styled run
agentPolicy.followUpGate: After applying generated patchOps to a copied deck, run i18n-style-diff and visual parity gates before delivery.

matching.logicalKey: kind + slideIndex + shapeId, falling back to shapeName and then message when no shape id exists
matching.changed: same logicalKey with changed severity or metrics

human inspect summary on stderr without inspect --json

usageNotes: Use `xdoc pdf inspect out.pdf --json --pretty` after converting a PPTX to PDF when diagnosing font embedding, font fallback, text extraction, or copy/search issues.
Use `xdoc pdf extract-text input.pdf --engine pdfium --json --pretty` to produce the shared pdf-text/v1 contract for CLI/API-compatible PDF text extraction.
`--engine auto` currently resolves to PDFium in native builds; `--engine pdflite` is exposed for comparison but returns engine_unavailable until the pure MoonBit reader lands.
`--pages` uses 1-based PDF page numbers, e.g. `1,3-5`.
The inspect backend is PDFium and adds no external runtime dependency beyond the PDFium runtime already used by xdoc PNG/PDF diagnostics.
For agent workflows, prefer --json --pretty and inspect summary.hasNonEmbeddedFonts, fonts[].embedded, fonts[].subset, fonts[].pages, and unicodeMapErrorCount fields.
embedded=null means PDFium observed the font through text extraction but could not match it to a page text object; treat it as a diagnostic warning, not proof of embedding.

outputs: pdf-text/v1 JSON on stdout or --output with --json

daemon.description: Run or control the local xdoc daemon used by AI Agent PPTX sessions.

json.description: Emit machine-readable daemon status JSON on stdout

inputs: daemon action: start, status, or stop
outputs: daemon status JSON on stdout when --json is set

usageNotes: Use `xdoc daemon start` to run the foreground loopback daemon for Agent multi-step PPTX editing.
Use `xdoc daemon status --json` to check whether a daemon is reachable.
Use `xdoc daemon stop` to ask the reachable daemon to shut down and remove its state file.
The daemon listens on loopback TCP by default; override with XDOC_DAEMON_ADDR when needed.
Deck sessions are pruned by idle timeout and max-session limits.

environment.XDOC_DAEMON_IDLE_MS: Override deck session idle timeout, default 300000.
environment.XDOC_DAEMON_AUTO_SPAWN: Set to 0 or false to disable pptx --daemon auto-spawn.
environment.XDOC_DAEMON_LOG: Override auto-spawn daemon stdout/stderr log path, default $TMPDIR/xdoc-daemon.log.

start.behavior: Start a foreground loopback daemon and write the state file.
